Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with a terrible headache on the left side since mid-day.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: Ohh, I just got a terrible headache since mid-day. Um on the left side.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The headache is a throbbing pain on the left side of the head and is not radiating.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Yeah, I guess it's, yeah I guess it's throbbing, um on that left side.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The pain is exacerbated by movement, such as leaning forward or moving the head/neck.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Well, like if I lean forward, or like move my head or neck, yeah, headache gets worse.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient experienced a visual aura with zig-zag lines and blurred vision in both eyes minutes before the headache started.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I noticed some zig-zag lines in my vision a few minutes before the headache started. My vision blurred... Both eyes, OK.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports photophobia (sensitivity to light) and is wearing sunglasses.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Yeah well I'm , wearing sunglasses right now. It's just, you know, the light's really hurting my eyes.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient feels nauseous and has vomited twice.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I just feel like I need to vomit... I vomited twice.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies fever, skin rashes, speech problems, limb numbness or weakness, balance issues, or recent head injury.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: no I don't feel feverish... No, I haven't noticed anything like that... Any problems with your speech at all? No... Numbness or weakness? No... balance or coordination? No.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient had a similar headache a few weeks ago that lasted a couple of days and resolved with painkillers and rest.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I did have a similar headache a few weeks ago... Couple of days... I had to take painkillers, and had to go go to bed and rest

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient has no other significant past medical history.
Past_Medical_History.source_text: Do you have any other medical history I should be aware of? Patient: No, nothing.

Medications.content: Patient takes Microgynon (a contraceptive pill) for the last three months.
Medications.source_text: Um I take the pill, Microgynon... three months.

Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.source_text: (Implicit from lack of mention when asked about medications and history)

Family_History.content: Mother has a history of migraines.
Family_History.source_text: My mum, my mum has, has migraines.
My mom has an underactive thyroid as well.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient lives alone and works in the fashion industry.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: I live on my own... I work in the fashion industry.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient reports high levels of stress from work but denies feeling down.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: Yeah it's really stressful, actually... I don't feel down, just a little bit stressed.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient is a non-smoker and does not drink alcohol.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: Do you smoke at all? and do you drink much in the way of alcohol? Patient: No. Patient: No.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient expressed significant concern about brain cancer, influenced by a friend's mother's death.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: I've read, you know if your headache gets worse if you move, it could be a sign of brain cancer... My, my friend's mum, she she recently died of a brain tumor.

Assessment.content: The impression is a migraine-type headache.
Assessment.source_text: I wonder whether you may, uh may have a migraine, uh migraine type headache.

Plan_of_Care.content: Change from combined oral contraceptive pill (COCP) to a progesterone-only pill (POP).
Advised to keep a headache diary to identify triggers.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: I think keeping a headache diary would be quite important

Plan_of_Care.content: Recommended regular strong painkillers (analgesia) such as Paracetamol, Co-codamol, Ibuprofen, or Naproxen for acute treatment.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: some strong painkillers would be advisable. So, think about Paracetamol, or even Co-codamol... and some anti-inflammatories, such as Ibuprofen and Naproxen.

Plan_of_Care.content: Discussion of prophylactic medications if headaches become more persistent.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: we could maybe think about giving you some medications that will stop your headaches from happening in the first place, something prophylactic medicines.

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient to review in one week to discuss prophylactic options.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: then we could have a discussion next time I see you next week, perhaps.

Follow_up_Information.content: Advised to return immediately if headache worsens, does not respond to medication, neck pain worsens, or if new weakness or vision changes develop.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: if your symptoms aren't getting better next two three days, or indeed they're getting worse. I'd like you to come back and see me, um straight away
